tasks.title: P30-01 — D101: the restored control cluster mounts, acts, and tells the truth (Q118 = RESTORE)
tasks.description: Restore the zoom/magnifier/Reset cluster in the live page (Q118 = RESTORE, final) so it mounts, acts and never advertises a refused state. `chart.html` gains a `#controls` toolbar, `chart.js::init` mounts it once per page load through `mountControlCluster()`, and a click applies the page's own `zoom(range, factor)` / `fitAndFollow()` locally then reports one `{"control", "value"}` on `LwBridge.controlPressed` and returns nothing; Python validates the id, calls the unchanged `handle_control`, and only the durable `router_mode` op returns (no page consumer is added for the published `zoom`/`reset_view` — a replayed log replays state, never steps). `mountControls` becomes idempotent per container and applies the three-branch latch rule, `ui/chart_controls.CONTROL_SPECS` becomes the one declaration `ui/lwc_view.CONTROL_IDS` derives from, and the new exported `syncControlState(op)` drives the magnifier's `aria-pressed` from the mode op. Four offscreen layers prove reachability (a DOM suite, a real-page-glue suite, the pytest bridge path, a four-way join); the painted page is owner-run G7 and no case, exit condition or record may claim it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the page loaded, Then a control container exists, `mountControls` has run exactly once per page load (and once after a render-process recovery), and each control id from the mirror is present in the DOM and activates the corresponding router action. (Measurable: DOM presence per id + an action assertion per control against the existing router seam; a page-recovery case asserting exactly one mount.)

Given a toggle control whose action is refused (TR-9), Then after the handler returns `aria-pressed` describes the app's actual state — it equals its pre-click value (revert) or the mode the router returned (drive-from-return), and in **neither** case does it read `true` for a refused state — and the refusal is reported exactly once. The refused path is tested from **both** starting states (off→refused, on→refused). (Measurable: attribute read before/after each refused click in both states + a report counter; a click-handler unit case driving `mountControls` with a refusing `onControl`.)

Given the end state, Then every control id in the mirror is reachable in the running page, and **no** control surface exists whose only callers are tests — the reachability check joins the mirror's ids to the DOM, so a surface that regresses to test-only fails it. (Measurable: the join of mirror ids → DOM ids → the action each performs; a negative case where an id is removed from the DOM and the check goes red.)

Given the restored cluster, When the user pans and zooms from the keyboard, Then the documented page affordances still work unchanged alongside the buttons. (Measurable: the existing keyboard/interaction tests, unmodified.)

Given the restored cluster, When a control is clicked in the page, Then its message reaches `LwcChartView.handle_control` through the bridge (the production caller that did not exist), the corresponding Python action runs, and no Python-side control surface remains referenced only by tests or by the mirror — `ChartControls` is either the receiving surface or its signal names are carried by a module production imports. (Measurable: an offscreen end-to-end click per control asserting the Python slot ran; a production-reference check for `handle_control` and `ChartControls` that fails on a test-only symbol.)

Given the working tree after this task, Then the only paths this task created or modified are `chart_assets/lwc/chart.html`, `chart_assets/lwc/interaction.js`, `chart_assets/lwc/chart.js`, `chart_assets/lwc/interaction.controls.test.js`, `chart_assets/lwc/controls.test.js`, `ui/chart_controls.py`, `ui/lwc_bridge.py`, `ui/lwc_view.py` and `tests/test_d101_control_cluster.py`; every named existing suite and `chart_assets/lwc/chart.test.js` is byte-identical to baseline `956f9f8` (`git diff --quiet 956f9f8 -- <paths>` exits 0); no case in either new suite mentions `QWebEngineView`, `grab(` or a screenshot (G7 stays owner-run and unclaimed); and no case invents a data-limit refusal — the only refusal driven is TR-9 (`enter_zoom` from `ALARM_PLACING`), while the no-visible-range press asserts no viewport change, no `zoomRefused`, one report (`FI-P30-1`).

tasks.title: P30-02 — D102 + D103: a popup dismissed by its owner, a selection restored by identity
tasks.description: Collapsing the watchlist dismisses its floating search-results popup, and a drawing-group checkbox toggle no longer wipes the drawing selection. `_apply_collapsed_visual` calls `clear_search_results()` on collapse (so every collapse path is covered: the header toggle, the collapsed bar, `toggle_collapsed`, `set_collapsed`), `show_search_results` clears and returns while collapsed so an in-flight result cannot resurrect the popup, and `DrawingGroupsDialog.reload` captures the selected drawing ids before rebuilding and re-selects the surviving ids by `UserRole` id — never by row index. The new suite proves the popup case can fail before it proves it passes (AR-P30-11) and asserts the restored selection is the set of surviving ids.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given visible search results, When the watchlist collapses, Then the popup is hidden and its items are cleared. (Measurable: `isVisible()` false + list count zero.)
Given a query in flight, When the panel collapses and the results arrive afterwards, Then the popup does not become visible. (Measurable: collapse → deliver results → visibility assertion.)

Given two selected drawings, When a group's `visible` (or `locked`) checkbox is toggled, Then the same drawing ids remain selected and the subsequent action receives them. (Measurable: selected-id list before/after + the action's received ids.)

Given a reload that reorders or shrinks the list, Then the restored selection contains exactly the surviving ids and nothing else. (Measurable: a fixture where a drawing is removed between selection and restore.)

Given the working tree after this task, Then the only paths created or modified are `ui/watchlist_panel.py`, `ui/drawing_groups_dialog.py` and `tests/test_d102_d103_surface_state.py`; `tests/test_d39_burst_search.py`, `tests/test_watchlist_collapsed_bar_d44.py`, `tests/test_dock_widths_collapsed_d44.py`, `tests/test_p9_group_dialog.py`, `tests/test_p9_group_payload.py`, `tests/test_p9_active_group.py`, `tests/test_p10_groups_dialog_lock.py` and `tests/test_drawing_store.py` are byte-identical to baseline `956f9f8` and green; no cancellation, debounce, service, settings key, extra widget or persistence change is made.
